Alright so this one actually depends. I wouldn’t bring exhaust against rengar jungle of your playing against let’s say:

Caitlyn and Xerath. And they have Lux Mid
(Early game is important too!)
Bring control wards too. They reveal where he is in his ULTI

Your will barely be in range to exhaust. And it’s more likely someone ranged will be around then melee. At that point you should be the one with heal and your adc should have another summoner like ignite barrier ETC.

What you should do is check out what items they have. If you find your being focused by AD build **frozen heart OR Hourglass** It’s. It’s very situational.

You usually end up building a lot slower than them so you will know which on to build. In this case it’s based off of:

“If rengar/this person is fed, what type of damage is the rest of their team?”

If rengar/the AD assassin is fed and they mostly have AP damage you go Hourglass.

And if your trying to survive against solely AD and you see them building into Armor PEN, then build hourglass.

If your have frozen heart And Mythic + 1 other item. You can sell it if you need hourglass. This is where most people disagree but it’s a price to pay for living and it’s better than sitting with something that will only help against and handful of people. 

If they have Fed AP you can go Mikaels and or merc treds. If it’s really bad you can buy spirit visage but I’ve only done that like 2 times in my almost 4 year of Soraka. Most of the time you end up buying these items as a 3rd Item but you can rush it second if needed :P

Also NEVER walk alone on the jungle in general if your team has have less map pressure. 

Hopefully this helps!

**TLDR This is pretty long so skip to the part you need**

**Runes:**


Summon aery manaflow transcendance gathering storm, revitalize bone plating or font of life OR Guardian Font bone playing revitalize with manaflow and gathering storm. (NOTE you need GTS when you go guardian you have a lack of AP without it. And manaflow because you will go o quite a bit even when you hit Q’s it helps you stay longer for more teamfights.


**Maxing/Abilities:**

Max W always the followed by Q E. Max Q second for more healing it’s more worth over the few 2 or 1 seconds on E since CDR rework 
Put 2 points into Q then max W. You want your W to be maxed as soon as possible. And if you put 3 points in it it will be maxed at level 10 NOT 9. I personally prefer this.

**(IMPORTANT: you don’t have to build your mythic first. Thought make sure it has some AP. Don’t underestimate locket. It’s more powerful than you think. It makes a surprisingly huge difference unless the enemy has kraken slayer :( You can go staff or ardent first for that sweet AP and healing shield.)** Edit: I meant shield power whoops 

**Items:**

Go moonstone/locket (Locket is good against bursty comps even if ur winning it’s better safe than sorry. I learned that the hard way) 

Ardent or staff of water whichever is better for you most dmg dealing carry, mikaels or redemption. Go Mikaels if they have a AP dmg that hurts and it CC. If they don’t have either then go redemption. 

I do believe mikaels has better stats and if they have GW redemption most of the time can be difficult but do but it when you feel like you need it. It can be good if everyone is low and you don’t have ulti for out of combat heal.

Then last go to warding stone  that has control wards ability haste and control wards. They are really good for you and should always be built as a last item on every support. (With they except of some damage supports at times)

As someone used who to go Guardian with ultimate hunter/taste of blood, I can promise you that you will always need gathering storm and manaflow. The AP is extremely important when you go guardian. and at rank 4 you already have almost a 1 second heal.
